name: Thistleshrub Valley
summary: Tran'rek in Gadgetzan wants to get into Thistleshrub Valley, but the strange beasts there keep them away. Clear some of the thistleshrubs out, and Tran'rek might think about going back.

sections.title: A Dangerous Valley
sections.body: Thistleshrub Valley lies south-west of Gadgetzan, and Tran'rek calls it a mighty dangerous place. They do not trust the strange beasts there, gnarled thistleshrubs and thistleshrub rootshapers, and with so many around they will not go back.

sections.title: Thinning the Thistleshrubs
sections.body: Tran'rek wants eight gnarled thistleshrubs and eight thistleshrub rootshapers cleared out. There is one condition: Tran'rek wants a closer look at the cactus in the valley, so some of it must be left in one piece.

faq.q: Who asks for help with Thistleshrub Valley?

faq.answer: Eight gnarled thistleshrubs and eight thistleshrub rootshapers.

faq.q: Why does Tran'rek want some of the cactus left in one piece?
faq.answer: Tran'rek wants to take a closer look at the cactus in the valley, so some of it should be left in one piece.
